title: Enterprise Request Provenance Hub & Initial Solution Brief
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a lightweight 'Provenance Hub' for Sales/CS to submit enterprise feature asks that preserves signal (account context, contact notes, ask origin, ROI claims) and emits an automated Initial Solution Brief (ISB) for rapid PM review. The hub should: (1) reduce noisy one-off tickets by surfacing similar historical asks, (2) produce a one-page econ + risk proxy to aid prioritization, and (3) provide a quick routing recommendation (self-serve product experiment, roadmap candidate, or custom engineering work). This ticket covers design of the submission template, backend mapping to account data, scoring heuristics, and a first-pass UI flow for CS reps in the Console.
acceptance_criteria: CS/Sales can submit an ask through the Hub with required fields (ask summary, business impact, expected timeline, contact/account) and optional attachment links
Hub automatically shows up to 5 historically similar requests and links to their resolution/outcome
System generates an Initial Solution Brief (one-page) with: problem statement, 2 candidate solutions, rough cost/t-shirt estimate, and routing recommendation
PMs can approve/modify routing recommendation and push ISB to backlog with a single click (creates a PM ticket stub with populated fields)
Econ proxy calculation uses account tier + usage + claimed ROI to output a high/medium/low economic priority label
tasks: Draft submission template fields and validation rules
Design quick ISB layout and required output fields (1-pager)
Implement similarity lookup against past intake tickets (indexing + fuzzy match) - ENG work
Prototype econ proxy formula and mapping to account attributes
Wireframe minimal Hub UI inside Console for CS reps
Define routing taxonomy and default thresholds for automated recommendations
Create PRD and handoff artifacts for engineering delivery
decision_log: 2025-11-22: Decided to require 'customer outcome' and 'approx spend impact' fields to improve econ proxy quality
2025-11-25: Chose simple TF-IDF + embedding hybrid for similarity search to balance precision and cost (ENG-19012)
2025-11-28: Agreed on conservative routing defaults: only 'self-serve experiment' auto-route if econ proxy == low and similarity found
2025-12-01: Opted to surface historical ticket outcomes but not auto-link to source PRs until data cleanup completes
